name: event-automator
description: Skip-Bo event tooling: write Art Requirements from approved One-Pagers, and translate UI strings using the professional translator's own corrections.
long_description:
Exposes the Skip-Bo Event Automator's backend to Claude Desktop.

Art Requirements: list and read the One-Pager briefs on file, then save a complete Art Requirement rendered into the production team's template. One save tool per event type, each carrying that type's own schema, so another event type's mechanics cannot be expressed.

Localization: an interactive panel (English in, six languages out) backed by a translation memory built from the third-party translator's delivered corrections. Text the translator has already approved, or that the game already ships, is reused verbatim; only genuinely new strings are translated, and per-language typography is applied by rule afterwards.
